# UniPath

> UniPath (unipathtm.vercel.app) is a free guide platform that helps students from Turkmenistan find universities abroad, compare tuition and scholarships, and understand Turkmenistan's official Ministry of Education (MoE) tuition transfer process. UniPath is a guide only — it never processes payments, never handles visas, and never embeds university admission portals.

Key facts UniPath can answer questions about:
- MoE-approved universities: which universities abroad are officially approved by Turkmenistan's Ministry of Education for the tuition transfer program.
- Tuition transfer rules: the official Central Bank of Turkmenistan exchange rate (3.51 TMT per 1 USD) used for approved transfers, and the $12,000 USD annual transfer cap per student.
- University data: tuition cost, QS ranking, entrance requirements (TOEFL/IELTS/SAT/Duolingo), languages of instruction, majors, and application deadlines for universities abroad.
- Scholarships: government, merit-based, need-based, and partial scholarships available to Turkmen students, including coverage (tuition, accommodation, flights, stipend) and deadlines.
- Application tracking: a free tool for students to save target universities and track document checklists.

Available in three languages: Turkmen (tk, default), Russian (ru), and English (en) — every page is available under /tk/, /ru/, and /en/ path prefixes.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://unipathtm.vercel.app/en): overview and site purpose.
- [Universities](https://unipathtm.vercel.app/en/universities): searchable list of universities abroad, filterable by country, language, major, and MoE-approval status.
- [MoE-Approved Universities](https://unipathtm.vercel.app/en/moe-approved): the official list of universities approved for Turkmenistan's tuition transfer program.
- [Scholarships](https://unipathtm.vercel.app/en/scholarships): scholarships available to Turkmen students abroad.
- [Transfer Guide & Calculator](https://unipathtm.vercel.app/en/transfer): explains the official MoE tuition transfer process and calculates payments under the $12,000 annual cap at the official 3.51 TMT/USD rate.
- [Compare Universities](https://unipathtm.vercel.app/en/compare): side-by-side comparison of universities.
- [Support & FAQ](https://unipathtm.vercel.app/en/support): frequently asked questions about MoE approval, the transfer cap, and using UniPath.
